chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Faḍḍāl narrated from Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb, who said:
I asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about castration, but he did not answer me. Then I asked Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام about that, and he said: “There is no harm in it.”

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh; the Imam being consulted
key_terms.أَبَا ٱلْحَسَنِ: Abū al-Ḥasan; the Imam who gave the answer
key_terms.سَأَلْتُ: I asked; indicates a direct legal inquiry
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it; an expression indicating permissibility

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith of Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام say about castration?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal inquiry about castration. Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb reports that when he later asked Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, the Imam gave the ruling that there is no harm in it.
